title: Evidence Curator Bridge for SOC 2 / ISO 27001 Assertion Packaging
creator: Priya Nair
description:
Problem: Customers running Redwood in hosted, dedicated, and private modes must prove control fulfilment for SOC 2 and ISO 27001 audits. Today we stitch evidence manually from multiple collectors (audit logs, access snapshots, retention policies, regional residency assertions), which is error-prone and slow.

Goal: Ship an "evidence-curator" bridge service and packaging schema that automates mapping runtime telemetry + retention settings to signed, region-scoped assertion bundles suitable for auditor consumption. The bridge will: 1) normalize telemetry from existing collectors, 2) apply control-to-evidence mapping rules for SOC 2/ISO controls, 3) generate immutable NDJSON manifests + signed artifact bundles per jurisdiction, and 4) push artifacts to customer-specific retention vaults (S3/GCS with KMS).

Scope: Implement mapping rules for a first tranche of controls (Access Logging, Key Management proofs, Data Residency assertions, Retention Snapshot), create curator microservice, CI for manifest generation, and a console view for bundle status. Integrations: runtime event stream, collector API, storage backends, and Console dashboard hooks.

Out of scope: full audit-report generation (PDF/wording for auditors), legal attestation signatures (handled by Compliance ops), and connectors for legacy on-prem dashboards (follow-up).
acceptance_criteria: Curator service deployed to staging that consumes normalized collector events and produces a per-region NDJSON manifest for each evidence bundle
Mapping rules for SOC 2 CC6 (Access Logging), ISO A.8 (Asset Inventory) subset, retention snapshots, and residency assertions are documented in Confluence and codified in the mapping repo
Bundles are signed with platform KMS keys and stored in customer retention buckets with correct region tags and lifecycle rules
Console shows bundle status (pending, ready, expired) and links to artifact locations; RBAC respects Private deployment tenant boundaries
End-to-end test that simulates a 24-hour window and produces a complete bundle for an enterprise test account; CI job validates manifest schema and signature

2025-03-03 | Priya Nair: Product review: UX for Console shows 'bundle ready' with quick download and 'audit view' link. PM asks for an 'evidence diff' to surface changes between bundles (helpful for regression detection) — added as follow-up enhancement.
